signIn.heading: Sign in to leave a comment, like or repost
signIn.anyAccount: Any {{atmosphereAccount}} works, including {{bluesky}}: one account for a whole network of open apps.
signIn.privacy: You'll approve this on your account's own site (Bluesky's, for most people); your password is never shared here. No account yet? {{createAccount}}.
elsewhere.text: Rather not sign in here? {{link}} It shows up here just the same, as do likes and reposts.
actions.label: Respond to this post
composer.quoting: Quoting this post on your own account
posted.quote: Your quote post is on Bluesky.
comment.author: Author
comment.deletePermission: To delete comments here, this site needs one more permission from your Atmosphere account. Alternatively, you can delete it {{link}}.
messages.signedIn: You're signed in. You can comment, like or repost above.
messages.signInFailed: Signing in didn't finish. Please try again.
messages.accountNotFound: We couldn't find that account. Check the handle and try again.
messages.invalidHandle: That doesn't look like a handle. It's usually something like alice.bsky.social.
messages.signedOut: You've been signed out. Please sign in again.
messages.needsPermission: That needs one more permission from your account.
messages.tooLong: Posts can be up to {{max}} characters.
messages.tooMany: You're going quickly. Please wait a minute and try again.
messages.error: That didn't work. Please try again.
dialog.heading: Sign in to like or repost
posted.notHere: It won't show on this page, but it's on Bluesky.
signIn.access: Your sign-in stays in this browser: this site's server never sees it and can't post for you, and signing out cancels it.
signIn.policy: How this site handles your data
composer.needsPermission: To comment here as {{handle}}, this site needs one more permission from your Atmosphere account.
comment.hideConfirm: Hide this comment here and on Bluesky? You can show it again in the Bluesky app.
comment.hidePermission: To hide comments here, this site needs one more permission from your account. You can also hide them in the Bluesky app.
permission.heading: One more permission
permission.follow: To follow {{handle}} from this site, it needs one more permission from your Atmosphere account: to follow and unfollow accounts.
permission.post: To reply and quote from this site, it needs one more permission from your Atmosphere account: to create posts.
permission.react: To like and repost from this site, it needs one more permission from your Atmosphere account: to like and repost, and to undo that.
permission.approve: Your account's own site (Bluesky's, for most people) will ask you to approve it, and may ask you to sign in there first. Then you'll come straight back here.
